title: Intel places first order for ASML's High-NA EUV production tool

sources.quote: Intel has issued its first purchase order to ASML for the delivery of the industry

explain: Intel ordered ASML's first TWINSCAN EXE:5200, a next-generation High-NA EUV lithography machine for printing the tiniest chip features. Each machine is reported to cost several hundred million dollars, but the order value was not disclosed.
